sourceChecks.text: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

profileDecisionJa: エフライムの子孫を挙げる系譜の中で、ザバドの子として名が記されます。本文は、家畜を奪いに来た彼らをガト出身者が殺したと述べます。
